question:
What is the average time in seconds of champion for each year, before year 1975?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: only champion's finished time is represented by 'HH:MM:SS.mmm'; finished the game refers to time is not null; before year 1975 refers to year < 1975;

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    r."XCL_066" AS year,
    AVG(t."XCL_085" / 1000.0) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM results t
JOIN races r ON t."XCL_074" = r."XCL_065"
WHERE t."XCL_078" = 1
  AND t."XCL_085" IS NOT NULL
  AND r."XCL_066" < 1975
GROUP BY r."XCL_066"
ORDER BY r."XCL_066"

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT r."XCL_066" AS year,
       AVG( (CAST(SUBSTR(t."XCL_084",1,INSTR(t."XCL_084",':')-1) AS INTEGER)*3600
            + CAST(SUBSTR(t."XCL_084",INSTR(t."XCL_084",':')+1, INSTR(t."XCL_084",':')-INSTR(t."XCL_084",':')-1) AS INTEGER)*60
            + CAST(SUBSTR(t."XCL_084",INSTR(t."XCL_084",':')+1) AS REAL)) ) AS avg_seconds
FROM results t
JOIN races r ON t."XCL_074" = r."XCL_065"
WHERE t."XCL_078" = 1
  AND t."XCL_084" IS NOT NULL
  AND t."XCL_084" NOT LIKE '+%'
  AND r."XCL_066" < 1975
GROUP BY r."XCL_066"
ORDER BY r."XCL_066"
